title: Nightmare PTA Moms
description: Hoping to get more involved at her daughter's new middle school, a woman joins the PTA, only to encounter a power-hungry mother who has a penchant for backstabbing.

title: Nightmare School Moms
description: Two mothers battle to see which of their overachieving daughters will be accepted to a prestigious university. However, when one of their methods quickly spirals out of control, the games turn deadly.

title: My Life Is a Lifetime Movie
description:

title: Acceptance
description: A woman (Joan Cusack) tries to help her teenage daughter (Mae Whitman) with the college-admissions process.

title: Deadly Match
description: Trina goes live with her unique dating website, and it becomes a huge success until she shuts it down to stop a prostitution hub. When one of the users from the site turns up dead, Trina looks to her now-defunct site for clues to solve the crime.

title: Dying to Be Loved
description: Jill's daughter takes up with a bad boy whose violent behavior lands the young couple in trouble. To avoid a stint in prison, they appear to commit a double suicide, but Jill sets out to prove they have gone on the run.
